verified: Rounds, an intelligence committee member, told Politico that Section 702 could be attached to the NDAA, and The Verge reports the authority has not technically lapsed despite a failed reauthorization vote.
unconfirmed: whether congressional leadership will actually attach the reauthorization, what its text and duration would be, and whether it can pass before the session ends — no filed bill or enacted text is cited, and the quoted remarks are truncated.

verified: The Verge 报道，参议员迈克·朗兹对 Politico 表示，FISA 第702条可能被附加到 NDAA；报道还称该监听授权尚未在法律上失效。
unconfirmed: 是否真会附加、附加文本的具体内容、续期时长和表决时间表均未公布；The Verge 引用的朗兹原话在报道摘要中被截断。

titles.en: FISA Section 702 reauthorization may ride on the defense bill
titles.zh: FISA 第702条续期或搭上国防授权法案，Politico 报道
